name: ZonaTecno
description: Importer and retailer of technology products in Uruguay: notebooks, phones, tablets, speakers, headphones, consoles, smartwatches and accessories. Ships nationwide with same-day options in Montevideo.
description_es: Importador y vendedor de productos tecnológicos en Uruguay: notebooks, celulares, tablets, parlantes, auriculares, consolas, relojes inteligentes y accesorios. Envía a todo el país con opciones en el día en Montevideo.

ships_to.notes: Nationwide; cost and time depend on product and location.
